trap-thesis-restatement.evidence: The block is two sentences and the second one, 'This provides an algebraic framework that captures the combinatorial constraints of the lepton sector.', adds no fact to the first. It names no constraint, no framework component and no consequence; it upgrades the single preceding claim into a grander unfalsifiable one. This is the closing-restatement construction in a block short enough that it is half the text.
trap-thesis-restatement.notes: flagged, not fixed — the remaining sentence's factual premise is itself in question (see below), so a rewrite is meaning-bearing, not mechanical. Proposed: delete the second sentence and state the concrete consequence instead, e.g. what the positive sign buys — the b_n are the continuant/Fibonacci polynomials in h, hence positive-coefficient and monotone in n, which is what makes the tower discrete and the inter-generation spacing h-controlled (the fact prf:lepton-continuant-recurrence's 'Structural content' section actually derives). MATH FINDING on the surviving sentence, not fixed inline: the claimed novelty does not survive checking. (a) The block calls the family a 'positive-sign Morgan--Voyce continuant', but Morgan--Voyce B_n, b_n satisfy the MINUS-sign recurrence B_n = (x+2)B_{n-1} - B_{n-2}, i.e. B_n(x) = U_n(1 + x/2) — Morgan--Voyce IS a rescaled Chebyshev U, so 'Morgan--Voyce, as distinguished from Chebyshev U_n' is self-undermining. The block's actual sequence b_{n+1} = h b_n + b_{n-1}, b_0=0, b_1=1 is the Fibonacci-polynomial / continuant family. (b) Even the plus-vs-minus contrast is a change of variable rather than a structural distinction: verified symbolically for n=1..7 that F_n(x) = (-i)^{n-1} U_{n-1}(i x / 2), so the positive-sign family is Chebyshev U at imaginary argument. What is genuinely notable is that the argument is h = q - q^{-1}, real and positive for q>1 — i.e. the tower sits on the hyperbolic branch — and that is a claim about the substrate, not about the recurrence being a new family.
